claims.claim: Gamma>0 permits finite expected-cost certification.

claims.claim: Every adaptive certifier costs at least log(1/delta)/Gamma in worst-case low-risk expectation.
claims.assumptions: 0<Gamma<infinity, eventual complete certification on low-risk class.
claims.verification_remaining: Independent check of truncation and minimax quantifiers.

claims.claim: Regularized construction costs at most [log(1/delta)+log(dmax/epsilon)]/Gamma_epsilon.

claims.claim: First-order minimax expected cost is log(1/delta)/Gamma.

claims.claim: Joint saddle score has composite-null expectation at most one and uniform good log drift.

claims.verification_remaining: Do not claim controllerwise conditional validity.

claims.claim: Virtual regularization pulls a score to unchanged raw records without altering agents.

claims.verification_remaining: Check raw logs and policy class remain unchanged in any implementation.

claims.claim: Gamma_epsilon monotonically converges to extended Gamma.
claims.assumptions: Compact pair class, finite alphabets.

claims.claim: Exact optimal alarm-only false-certification risk is (1-eta)(1-beta)^N.
claims.assumptions: Only alarm data; zero-alarm clean agents; convex high-risk class; at most N runs.
claims.verification_remaining: Do not apply lower bound to full contextual traces.

claims.claim: Uncovered target mass u gives beta=a[(tau-u)/(1-u)]_+.

claims.claim: Zero-alarm budgets in the report are exact for the gate model.
